label: the precondition for any second verifier; no claim
core_rule: core_sha256 = sha256(utf8(jcs(core))); core = verify() output minus verifier minus coverage
set_rule: set_sha256 = sha256(utf8(jcs(index minus set_sha256 minus provenance)))
blob_rule: blobs.json maps sha256 -> base64; every blob hashes to its key; a JSON blob is UTF-8 text, indent 1, LF
sources_note: the /v2 step's own source (papers/sworn/NOTE_certifies_correction_2026_10_24.md): one core per clause of the /v2 certifies sentence that a document, a manifest and an in-memory tree can show, and /v2, /v1 and /v0 receipts checked by a verifier that issues /v2

observer.note: outside set_sha256: the observer's and the build's numbers (C4)

requires_legend.manifest: a sworn/manifest/0.x object was given; a second verifier for rN and embedded blobs must pass these
requires_legend.tree: a tree snapshot was given (SnapshotTree semantics, C10); a second verifier may skip these and must report how many it skipped, per family
requires_legend.git: only a live git object store reproduces this; no vector in v0.1 carries it
requires_legend.observer: styxx.claimdetect; never required and never pinned (C4)

commit_form.match: commit must be a full lowercase hex object id or None

lexical_malformed.match: cannot carry a lexically MALFORMED declaration

round_trip.match: canonical round trip does not reproduce the document bytes

sidecar_commit_form.match: sidecar commit must be a full lowercase hex object id or null

sidecar_text_not_string.match: sidecar text must be a string

sidecar_text_not_utf8.match: sidecar text is not encodable as UTF-8

sidecar_document_shape.match: sidecar document must carry a string name and a string sha256

sidecar_text_digest.match: sidecar text does not hash to document.sha256

sidecar_spans_not_list.match: sidecar spans must be a list

sidecar_span_shape.match: is not an object with exactly start/end/receipt/kind

sidecar_span_range.match: are not a non-empty range in the text

sidecar_spans_overlap.match: spans are not ordered and non-overlapping

sidecar_span_boundary.match: is not on a UTF-8 character boundary

sidecar_span_attribute.match: cannot be carried by the inline tag grammar

manifest_receipts_shape.match: manifest receipts must be an object keyed by receipt id

manifest_authored_shape.match: manifest authored_sha256 must be a list of hex strings

manifest_disagrees.match: the supplied manifest disagrees with the embedded one

sidecar_no_canonical_form.match: the sidecar text has no canonical form

sidecar_declaration_unrepresentable.match: carries a declaration the sidecar form cannot represent

provenance.note: outside set_sha256: which bytes generated the set, not what the set pins (C7)
